description: This file defines the NetworkIsolationKey class, including its constructors, methods for serialization, debugging, and state checks, within the net namespace. It manages network isolation keys based on site and origin information, with support for cross-site flags and nonces.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey
classes.description: Represents a key used for network isolation, based on site and origin information, with support for cross-site flags and nonces. Provides methods for serialization, debugging, and state validation.

methods.name: NetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the NetworkIsolationKey with various site, origin, and nonce configurations.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient (non-persistent) network isolation key with opaque sites.

methods.name: CreateWithNewFrameSite
methods.description: Creates a new NetworkIsolationKey with a specified new frame site, preserving the nonce.

methods.name: ToCacheKeyString
methods.description: Serializes the key into a string suitable for cache keys, depending on the mode.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the key's state for debugging.

methods.name: IsFullyPopulated
methods.description: Checks if the key has all necessary site information populated.

methods.name: IsTransient
methods.description: Determines if the key is transient (not fully populated or opaque).

methods.name: GetMode
methods.description: Static method to determine the current mode based on feature flags.

methods.name: GetFrameSite
methods.description: Returns the frame site if mode is site-based.

methods.name: GetIsCrossSite
methods.description: Returns whether the key is cross-site if mode is cross-site flag based.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if both top and frame sites are empty.

methods.name: IsOpaque
methods.description: Checks if the key is considered opaque based on site opacity and nonce.
